name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-birthday-calendar
title: Birthday Calendar View
shortDescription: Shows team birthdays from a SharePoint list on a month calendar, with person cards showing department, job title and office, and one-click email or Teams greetings. No Microsoft Graph permissions required.
longDescription: A SharePoint Framework web part that shows your team's birthdays on a month calendar. Each birthday is a pill in its day cell; selecting one opens a person card with department, job title, office and phone from the SharePoint user profile, plus one-click Email and Teams buttons to send a greeting. A 'Coming up' strip lists the next birthdays. The web part reads a plain SharePoint list that people opt into - the list title and every column's internal name are configurable in the property pane - and needs no Microsoft Graph permissions, no tenant-admin API approval and no Azure Function.

thumbnails.alt: Birthday Calendar View showing a month grid with birthday pills, a 'Coming up' strip and today highlighted
